result.title: What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation
result.comment: Accepted to TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/loc/sydney/178197
result.summary: Video understanding evaluations are intended to measure a model's proficiency in video perception and task solving. However, current VideoQA benchmarks struggle to isolate these capabilities due to their reliance on multiple-choice (MC) answer guidance, language priors, and fragile scoring pipelines. Disentangling these confounding factors reveals how much of a model's score is supplied by the evaluation context rather than earned through faithful perception. Across six VideoQA benchmarks of varying length, we find that accuracy is significantly above chance without any visual input. This is caused by shortcutting and option-prior reliance. We express these effects in the language of faithfulness: option-exploitation and answer-conditioned reasoning traces are unfaithful even when they are correct. Together, our results show that a VideoQA score is jointly determined by language priors, option timing, and how outputs and labels are converted into correctness. We produce a novel Option-Delayed Replay (ODR) mechanism that discloses options at controlled stages of an open-ended (OE) trajectory, to obtain objective MC scores from faithful option-free inference. Our work demonstrates that agentic methods with ODR and faithful inference can match option-exploiting performance. Finally, we formalize our diagnostic collection and ODR as a reproducible evaluation protocol, and we release a human-relabelled edition of LVBench (correcting $20.5\%$ of keys) to remove annotation noise as a confounding variable.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作考察 VideoQA 多选题评测究竟测到了什么：在六个基准上发现无视觉输入时准确率仍显著高于随机，并将其归因于选项先验与捷径依赖。作者用「选项利用」和答案条件化的推理轨迹刻画不忠实性，提出 Option-Delayed Replay（ODR），在开放式推理轨迹的受控阶段才披露选项，以获得去除选项泄露的客观分数，并把诊断流程整理为可复现协议、发布重标注的 LVBench。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心问题是分数是否真正来自视觉证据而非上下文捷径，与 LVR 关心的答案是否使用视觉/latent 内容、证据筛选和不忠实推理轨迹直接相关；ODR 可提供一种在受控时点插入选项、检验视觉旁路的评测思路，值得核查其是否适用于 latent 推理状态的分析。
